info.title: Flyo Nitro - Block collections
info.description: Blocks whose collection is typed: two collections (one with the sort, links and page size pinned, one without), a block that is no collection but aggregates facets, and a block with neither.

items.description: Iterated content pool items mapped to block fields.

link.description: Generated detail-page link for the item.

slots.description: Named slot containers for nested blocks.

collection.title: Event List Collection
collection.description: How the items of the block are delivered.

enabled.description: Whether the items of this block are a collection.

per_page.description: The items per page, set in the block definition.

inline_first_page.description: Whether the page JSON carries the first page in items.

page_count.description: The number of pages, at least 1.

current_page.description: The page items holds, starting at 1.

sort.description: The sort of this page. Null when the block is no collection.

links.description: Absolute urls on the collection endpoint. Null when the block is no collection.

base.description: The collection without page, sort or filter.

prev.description: The previous page, null on the first.

next.description: The next page, null on the last.

facets.title: Event List Collection Facets
facets.description: The distinct values of every mapping item the block aggregates.

count.description: The number of items that carry the value.
